title: Great for Caring for Bedridden Patients!
text: Great for Caring for Bedridden Patients!. These have been wonderful for my husband since he broke his back and cannot get into the shower with his back brace. There is nothing to rinse off and he feels clean. They are very gentle on the skin . It is very easy to wash a bedridden patient with these wipes as they are very thick. No dripping water on the bed and they can be warmed for a couple seconds in the microwave, which makes them very soothing.

product_metadata.title: Comfort Bath Cleansing Washcloths, 8 Pack of 8 Washcloths
